notes.title: The game release as is
notes.notes:
Hello!

According to the last changes on Steam store (which influenced small indie game sales) there are no value in finishing AXYOS at all. Sadly, but we're couldn't get enough resources to polish and promote the game so we're decided to release it as is, so that you no longer have questions about game release.

The game servers, of course, will work as before. Nevertheless, we will finish the AXYOS: Battlecards multiplayer card-game in a few months without "Early Access". We're not counting big sales but hope you will like it :)

notes.title: Game description update and news!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The game description was updated to get players 100% match expectations of what the game have at the moment.

We're sorry that there were no news and updates of the AXYOS for some time. The team is busy (we also should work on the other projects) but still continuing to work on the AXYOS concept (MOBA + FPS mix) and support the game servers.

It's hard for us to develop AXYOS on the old engine so we're preparing to move and update all the game assets and mechanics to the new game engine.

notes.title: Second patch for update #1
notes.notes:
Step by step, we making the game better with you, guys!

[b]There is changelist of the patch:[/b]
[list]
[*]Healthbar now appears only after you mark enemy with aim. Also bar shows caused damage.
[*]Added "Team DM" game mode in two options: normal and hardcore.
[*]Invisibility available within in-game shop as item with 30 seconds delay.
[*]Hit effects updated. Now they show hit direction.
[*]Enhanced controls settings. You can rebind almost every button.
[*]Added ability to toggle aim mode.
[*]Mouse sensitivity range increased.
[*]Improved displaying of object icons on screen. Now important objects nailing to screen borders if they out of it.
[*]Autobalance during the game. Autokick for causing a lot of damage to your team (for the hardcore mode).
[*]Balance of spread and recoil of weapons. Adjusted shoot animations for aiming mode. Weapon inertia effect is limited.
[*]Barrels explosion delay is decreased. Fixed aim for M4. Gas color changed to acid-green. VFX of rockets of bombing is updated.
[*]Rework of MAARS robot AI. Now by single pressing of robot-button you can set movement point and by double pressing you make robot following your current position.
[*]Fixing of various bugs.

[img]https://pp.vk.me/c629420/v629420704/1b63b/aiikjkAj628.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Balance patch and Trading Cards
notes.notes:
Hi! There is a new patch with some changes listed below. Bots will be added soon.
Oh, yes. In a few days we'll finally add Trading Cards!

[img]https://cs7059.vk.me/c624018/v624018704/33237/bXKFOVq-WEY.jpg[/img][img]https://cs7059.vk.me/c624018/v624018704/33245/DNeFuzDK-Es.jpg[/img]

[Common]
- enemy footsteps became 3 times louder
- visual improvements of the port map
- some optimization should boost FPS

[Parameters]
- vertical recoil of all weapons was reduced in two times, 1.5x reduced horizontal
- spread of all weapons was reduced on 5%
- maximum respawn delay was reduced from 20 down to 12 seconds

[Weapons]
- RPG7 now has only 1 additional rocket, cost is increased to 800
- RPG7 was fixed when in invisibility mode
- SVD cause more damage. to make kill usually enough 2 hits
- RPK shoot sound became quieter
- rebalace of the M24 sniper rifle

notes.title: Update news
notes.notes:
Hello fellas! My name is Andrey and I’m from Axyos Games team.

Lately, we worked on a new experimental game mode named “Hide and Seek”, which primary is about stealth and hiding. It has been included in one of the last updates.

Then, we improved mechanics and dynamics of the game. As result, it’s more comfortable to play now. In addition, there has been added a new map in two styles – sunny and horror. So, check it out on the new US and EU servers and have a good day!

Oh, yes. There is a 50% discount!
